verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs claim variance analysis and budget tracking. Its Scan AI analyst runs variance analysis with materiality thresholds and suggests break-out dimensions such as vendor. The docs also mention drill-down in its Excel/Sheets workflows and agent answers with clickable, cited sources. However, none of this explicitly shows budget-vs-actuals sliced by department and account, or drilling from a variance to the underlying transactions. missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actuals reporting by department and account, documented transaction-level drill-down from a variance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
